purpose: Classify the startup routine that initializes the VDP/font path and renders the regional compatibility warning.

routine.name: System_DisplayRegionCompatibilityWarning
behavior: Expands the startup font bank into VRAM.
Renders the regional compatibility warning and selected regional variant.
Spins after the warning display is complete.

helper.name: System_WriteRegionWarningText
helper.behavior: Converts the warning text position and character code to a VDP tile address, emits the character sequence, and returns to the renderer.

runtime_initializer.name: Game_InitializeAndEnterFrameLoop
runtime_initializer.behavior: Initializes the runtime and performs the first complete scene/actor/player/render service pass before transferring to Game_FrameUpdateLoop at 0x001A8C16.

boundaries.preceding_code: The sequential reset path branches away at 0x00000340; this routine has its own aligned entry at 0x00000344.
